name: tts-cpp
description: Text-to-speech in pure C++/ggml: Resemble Chatterbox (Turbo + Multilingual), Supertonic, Fun-CosyVoice3, Parler-TTS, Audio8, and LavaSR speech enhancement. Sourced from tetherto/qvac-ext-lib-whisper.cpp (engines/tts). This release advances the pin from 21f12102 to master 7ca7369c (QVAC-22776) and enables CosyVoice3 GPU execution on Vulkan for desktop Linux and Windows: the engine's backend requirement admits Vulkan positively on those platforms (Android keeps Metal-or-OpenCL, so Mali / Xclipse devices still decline to CPU, and the ARM Mali opt-in is now enforced on every platform inside the selection walk). Every CosyVoice3 LM matmul requests f32 accumulation - ggml-vulkan reduces f16/quantized matmuls in f16 under the default precision and greedy decode compounds one near-tie argmax flip into a divergent trajectory; the flag is inert on CPU/Metal/OpenCL. Guarded by per-stage GPU parity gates (llm bit-identical to the CPU trajectory for f32 and q8_0 weights across coopmat modes; flow on a cross-backend cosine plus absolute log-mel bound; hift on f0 cosine/Hz/voiced-decision parity plus an unpinned production-path energy-envelope gate). Also fixes an ODR collision between three TU-local model_ctx definitions whose folded implicit destructors could run against the wrong struct layout in static-library consumers. New EngineOptions::vulkan_device pins the Vulkan adapter (-1 auto-picks the discrete card). The ggml-speech floor stays at 2026-08-07.
